query: Consider the following context: During the hot dip aluminum plating process, components such as sinking rollers, pulling rollers, and guide plates will come into long-term contact with high-temperature liquid aluminum and be corroded by the aluminum liquid, greatly reducing their service life. In that context, which material can be used for prepare parts for the dipping and plating equipment and protect the equipment from erosion, and why?

generation.hypothesis: Using a nickel-based alloy for components in hot dip aluminum plating equipment will significantly reduce corrosion compared to traditional materials.
generation.intervention: Exposure to high-temperature liquid aluminum during the hot dip plating process
generation.conditions: High-temperature environment typical of aluminum plating
generation.mechanism: Nickel-based alloys form a protective oxide layer that prevents aluminum from penetrating and corroding the underlying material.
generation.predicted_outcome: Increased service life of the components compared to those made from traditional materials.
generation.baseline: Traditional materials currently used in hot dip aluminum plating equipment
generation.boundary: Components exposed to high-temperature liquid aluminum
generation.uncertainty: The specific performance of the nickel-based alloy under varying temperatures and aluminum compositions is not fully established.

falsification_experiment.design: Conduct a comparative study of nickel-based alloy components and traditional materials in a controlled hot dip aluminum plating environment.
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the corrosion rate of the nickel-based alloy is not significantly lower than that of traditional materials, the hypothesis is falsified.
